This cash drain coincides with rising debt, as borrowings climbed to Rs 57.93 Cr in Mar 2026 from Rs 47.22 Cr a year prior [E38]. Furthermore, promoters have steadily reduced their stake from 75.00% in Sep 2023 to 67.82% as of Jun 2026 [E40], signaling potential insider caution.
